grades.title: Grades
grades.subtitle: Performance report — view only.
grades.readOnlyNotice: Grades cannot be entered here. Only the subject teacher enters grades on the "Journal" page.
grades.parentNotice: These are your child's grades. See the "Ranking" page for the place in class. For questions about a grade, contact the subject teacher or the homeroom teacher.
grades.chooseHint: In day view the columns are the lessons of that day. In week view each subject gets one column per day.
grades.topNHint: For example 7 marks the top 7 places. Leave empty to rank the whole class.
grades.dayHint: All grades of the day and the place in class.
grades.weekHint: Monday to Saturday. Each subject has one column per day plus a subject average.
grades.needClass: Select a class to see the report.
grades.noLessons: No lessons scheduled for this period.
grades.noStudents: No active students in this class.
